Vienna × Amsterdam 🇦🇹🇳🇱 restaurant_herzig florisvstraalen vanoostrestaurant One Michelin-starred kitchen. Two chefs. One unforgettable four-hands dinner. For one special evening at Herzig, Sören Herzig welcomed Floris van Straalen of VanOost Amsterdam for a menu that brought two distinct culinary worlds together. From Balfegó akamé with mikan, nori & bergamot, to eel with herbs & horseradish, Indonesian langoustine with sambal & bumbu, black hake with crispy salad, ’nduja & Sauternes, sweetbread with yuzu, truffle & artichoke, and finally pigeon with beetroot, fig leaf & pistachio ajo verde. A beautiful dialogue between Vienna and Amsterdam — playful, precise and full of character. #vien
